configuration_policy: Correct the dated launch exterior; later race photographs are cross-checks, not proof of unchanged parts. No complete Madrid configuration is claimed.

sources.observation: Front photograph of Leclerc: wishbones meet the body and upright; thin fairings rather than uniform round tubes. The Ferrari section reports a rear suspension fairing profile update. The floor-bib claim belongs to Red Bull, not Ferrari.
sources.limitations: Perspective image cannot establish suspension hardpoint coordinates or hidden mechanisms. The rear fairing update remains annotation-only.

sources.observation: Front suspension joins the narrowing body; front-quarter photography corroborates separate thin floor-edge surfaces.
sources.limitations: Small distant surfaces do not resolve floor-slot dimensions, support count or a complete diffuser. FIA-reported rear winglet changes are separately documented in aero-2026-09-14.json.

component_notes.suspension: Exterior coherence correction: inboard ends seat 4 mm into each team's evaluated body shell; closed flattened wishbone fairings and wheel uprights replace floating round rods. The front axle-like bar is removed. Launch views and September 11 front photography support the general arrangement; hardpoints, fairing sections and concealed joints are estimates. This does not reconstruct Ferrari's Madrid rear-fairing upgrade.
component_notes.floor: Dated launch floor outline retained. Separate thin edge laminates now leave a visible open gap with connecting bridges. Launch rear-quarter/overhead images and current race photographs support layered exterior surfaces; exact gap, bridge positions/count and concealed underside remain illustrative estimates. No September floor upgrade or additional unsupported slit array is claimed.
component_notes.rear_wing: Dated launch airfoil outlines retained with thin slot separators and hinge barrels derived from the same section coordinates. Launch rear-quarter and overhead views support the slotted arrangement. Small support dimensions and hinge construction are estimates; September Mercedes winglet revisions are not backdated into this configuration.
component_notes.diffuser: Exterior coherence correction: continuous curved expansion skin, joined outlet walls and a thin laminate return replace a rounded sparse quad with disconnected flat strakes. The visible rear opening is checked against launch rear-quarter imagery. Channel count, internal shape and exact outlet section remain estimates; no newly evidenced diffuser upgrade is claimed.

rights: External photography is used for reference only and is not bundled into the model or public release assets. All geometry is originally authored.
